content.title: How To Watch The Age Of Attraction Reunion
content.text: When Is the Age Of Attraction Reunion And Where Can You Watch It?Plot twist: you won't find this episode on Netflix@Netflix Age of Attraction has wrapped its first season on Netflix, with the release of the eighth and final episode showing which of our remaining couples chose to commit to each other on Commitment Day... Of course, their love stories didn't stop once cameras stopped rolling. After the show came to an end, our age gap couples had to take their relationship away from cameras and into the real world - and luckily for us, the reunion is now here to catch us up with what we missed. It was announced on the day of the finale that an Age of Attraction reunion will be taking place, although not quite in the way fans expected. Despite the dating show airing on Netflix, the reunion is set t be hosted over on host Nick Viall's YouTube channel, The Viall Files. And judging by the seating chart posted to Nick's Instagram, we could be in for some serious drama... So when does the reunion air, where can you watch it, and which couples will be appearing? Here's everything we know so far about the Age of Attraction reunion. When is the Age of Attraction reunion released? The Age of Attraction reunion will air on Wednesday 1st April, at 4pm PT. For our Brit fans, timezone differences mean it'll land at midnight (so it'll be all ready to watch when you wake up on Thursday morning!) Unlike the show itself, the Age of Attraction reunion won't be airing on Netflix. Instead, it'll land over on Nick Viall's YouTube channel, The Viall Files. It's not known exactly why the reunion isn't getting a Netflix release, but as it stands, it seems YouTube will be the only way to watch for now! Who will be at the Age of Attraction reunion? We know that hosts Nick Viall and Natalie Joy will be at the reunion, joined by almost all of our Age of Attraction cast to delve into which relationships really stood the test of time. Those confirmed to be attending are John Merrill, Theresa DeMaria, Andrew Wheeler, Libby Vodicka, Logan Goodrid, Vanessa Drozda, Leah Woolfolk, Chris Dahlan, and Derrick Fleming. Despite leaving the show early, Vanelle Fenmou and Jorge Sanchez will also appear. The only contestant who won't be present is Pfeifer Hill, who was previously dating Derrick. In the first few second of the reunion trailer, Nick is heard asking, 'It looks like Pfeifer is not here. Does anyone know where she is?' Why wasn't Pfiefer at the Age of Attraction reunion? During Age of Attraction, Pfiefer told Derrick that she was ready to take the leap and move from Seattle to Dallas to be with him and his kids. Spoiler alert: things didn't go to plan. ©Netflix During an interview with Entertainment Tonight, Derrick confirmed that the move never happened, and that he and Pfeifer were no longer together. So, did Pfeifer skip the reunion to avoid seeing her ex, or was there another reason for her absence? From the looks of things on social media, Pfeifer was actually on a trip to Japan at the time that press took place, which could explain her absence. However, she's also hinted on social media that there's a little bit more to the story. When asked by a fan about why she chose not to attend, Pfeifer cryptically said, 'I can talk more on this after it airs on April 1st.' It comes after Pfiefer opened up on social media about being made to feel like she 'needed to be sexier' during filming by the production team. 'It wasn't like they were explicitly pressuring me to do anything,' she explained, 'but when you're put in that situation, everyone's there to shoot something. That environment just makes you feel like there is a pressure to dive them what they want.' Saying that a past assault had left her struggling with intimacy, she insisted that Derrick was 'completely so supportive during this,' and noted that she never felt 'psychologically messed with by the show.' ‘Generally speaking, the show was absolutely phenomenal. I’m so grateful that I had the opportunity to b e involved in this experience,' she added. Will there be an Age of Attraction season two? So far, Netflix hasn't announced whether there'll be a second season of the show. We certainly loved the first, so here's hoping. Is there an Age of Attraction reunion trailer?
